reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "[BUGFIX] Fix duplicate kubelet targets for nodes reporting several addresses of the same IP family", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: On nodes that report several addresses of the same IP family, the duplicate kubelet scrape targets go away, so the set of kubelet targets changes.
consequence.remediation: Check any dashboards or alerts that may have been built around the duplicate kubelet targets.

proposed.statement: The prometheus-operator bundled in kube-prometheus-stack 90.0.0 (operator v0.93.1) no longer creates duplicate kubelet targets for nodes that report several addresses of the same IP family.
